contexts.text: The material sphere... is a sphere of effluvia...
Like the effluvium around plants... There that effluvium is not material...
A wave of effluvia is continually flowing forth from man, animal, tree, fruit, shrub, flower, metal, and stone...
Nor could any worms he procreated from the effluvia from the earth...
Every particle of dust... exhales from its essence a subtle something as an effluvium...
There is as it were a sphere of spiritual effluvia...
They being as it were bound by his effluvium.
Their effluvium is like the effluvium of horses () = the intellectual proprium.
Their proprium draws its delight from the unclean effluvia... from the decayed things in the body...
